title: Each check is one SELECT in its row, and Lathe's checks are named and placed in order
when: Lathe's check rows are read.
then: Each is one SELECT or WITH statement in its row, with its name, its position in order, and only kinds of the schema.

title: Reading a record's history leaves the repo as it was
when: GET /api/history is asked for a record, twice.
then: It answers, and the repo's status and local config are as they were.

title: The engine, the server, the desktop app and their tests import Node's built-in modules by their node: name
when: Every source and test file of the engine, the server, the CLI, the desktop app and their tests is scanned for imports of Node's built-in modules.
then: Each names its module with the node: prefix; none imports a built-in module by its bare name.

title: No tracked file names a client product, a person or a machine's path
when: Every text file `git ls-files` lists is scanned for a client product's name, a person's first name and absolute home or temp paths.
then: None is found outside the allow-list of the author fields, the package name and the repo URL's owner; each finding names its file and line.

title: Every check row has a test that breaks it, from a product that breaks none
when: Reads Lathe's check rows and the checks the test file describes, and loads the complete product.
then: Expects the same check names in both, and no problem on the complete product.

title: Each new or changed test runs at the lowest level that can observe its result
manual_reason: Whether a lower level could observe a test's result is a judgment about what the test expects, which no scan of the code can make.
when: A reviewer reads each test record a change adds or changes, with the test case its file runs, before the change merges.
then: Each runs at the lowest level that can observe what it expects, or its notes say why the level below cannot; each flow test runs at its interface's level.

title: A use case goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a use case, a requirement a step fulfills, a flow with its steps and test, and a use case test a business outcome is measured by.
then: Expects the use case gone whole, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers, with no file changed.

title: A removal takes the record's parts and the links it starts
when: Removes a record with part rows and links of its own.
then: Expects the record, its parts and its links gone from the tables and the files.

title: A record others reference is refused removal, naming what references it
when: Removes a requirement that a step fulfills and a test sits under, a pattern setting a rule names, and a value object a field is typed by.
then: Expects each refused as `referenced`, its message naming every link and row that references the record.

title: An aggregate goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes an entity with its fields and data model, an invariant with its test, and an aggregate whole, and a record still referenced from outside what goes.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A domain event goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes an event type, and an event whole with its fields and event type, and a record still referenced from outside what goes.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A command goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a handler, an event handler, a policy test, a policy with what is under it, and a command whole, and a record still referenced from outside what goes.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A specification goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a predicate, a test and a specification whole, and a specification a query selects by.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A value object goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a constraint test, a constraint with its test, a value type and a value object whole, and a value object a field types.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A read model goes whole with what it holds, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a query handler, a projection, a query with its handler and a read model whole, and a read model its table stores.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: A table goes whole with its keys, and is refused while anything outside references it
when: Removes a table with its keys and links, and a table another table's foreign key points at.
then: Expects each record to go with what sits under it and the links they start, and each removal of a record still referenced refused, naming its referrers.

title: An aggregate with more entities than the limit is a warning naming it, the count and the limit
when: An aggregate has more entities than max_entities_per_aggregate.
then: aggregate-too-large names it, its count and the limit.

title: A capability starting with The or an -ing word, naming an interface or holding a list is a warning; a noun phrase or a single -ing noun is not
when: Capabilities titled Invoice management, Billing, The catalog, Writing invoices, Web app, Tools, members and loans, and String lending are added.
then: title-breaks-convention warns of The catalog, Writing invoices, Web app and the list, each naming the rule broken, and of none of the others.

title: A use case naming one of its product's interfaces, an interface word or a list is a warning; one goal of verb and object is not
when: Use cases are added that name the command line, the product's Member portal, a page and APIs, that hold a list with a comma, and that join objects with and, refund a fee or grant capital approval.
then: title-breaks-convention warns of each that names an interface word or holds a list after a comma, and of none of the others, an interface word inside a longer word (capital) included.

title: A use case titled with a CRUD verb over a record or data is a warning
when: Adds use cases titled Change a product's data, Edit a record, Update the data and Change Lathe's schema with a migration.
then: Expects title-breaks-convention to warn of the first three, each naming the CRUD verb, and not of the last, whose verb is not over a record or data.

title: A title another record of its kind and product has, or one ending with a period, is refused
when: An aggregate titled " loan " is added beside the aggregate Loan, and an invariant is titled with a period at its end.
then: title-unique refuses both aggregates, naming the other; the entity Loan beside the aggregate Loan loads; title-period refuses the invariant.

title: Every name in Lathe and the Tool Library is one to four words with no article first
when: Reads the titles of every name kind in Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library's.
then: None is longer than four words or starts with A, An or The.

title: A query not starting with Get, List or Find is a warning
when: Queries titled Get a loan, find a tool by name, Show overdue loans and Getaway tools are added.
then: query-title-verb warns of Show overdue loans and Getaway tools only.

title: A flow not titled by its use case, in or through, and its interface is a warning
when: A flow is titled in the pattern in several letter cases, then Borrow at the desk; then its use case is renamed.
then: flow-title-off-pattern passes each title in the pattern, warns of Borrow at the desk with the title to give it, and warns again once the use case is renamed.

title: Every policy in Lathe and the Tool Library reads When an event, then its reaction
when: Reads every policy's title in Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library's.
then: Each starts with When, its event, a comma and its reaction.

title: A specification starting with A, An or The is a warning
when: Specifications titled The tool is free, an active member, Theme is set and Area is open are added.
then: specification-title-article warns of the first two only.

title: A test titled Tests that or Should is a warning, a result is not
when: Use case tests titled Tests that…, Should…, Test whether…, Tests run one at a time and a result are added.
then: test-title-not-a-result warns of the first three only.

title: A code-bound title with whitespace, or an endpoint not titled by its method and route, is refused
when: Titles a command handler `the loan opener` and a table `Loans by member`; titles an endpoint `Borrow a tool`; then adds a data model titled `loan` for TL-LEND-EN02 beside the data model `Loan`.
then: Expects `title-form` to refuse the handler and the table, the handler's message saying a command handler is titled by one identifier exactly as in code, with no whitespace; the endpoint refused by a `check`; and the data model `loan` to load, since code compares exactly.

title: Every kind has at most one lead text, required, and every test a required When and Then and no Given
when: Reads the schema of Lathe's own spec: every kind, part and declaration table's columns and CHECKs.
then: Expects no table with two of statement, goal, meaning and description, every one of them NOT NULL with its trim CHECK, the ten tests with When and Then required and no Given, and no description on the data model, value type, predicate, event type, service, table, flow and flow step.

title: A product kind with an optional lead text, or two, is refused
when: Declares a description field on the fixture's CLI command kind that is not required, then a required description and a statement, then one required description.
then: Expects the first refused as a lead that must be required and the second as a second lead after description, both `product-kind`; the third loads.

title: No query handler or projection imports a repository or an aggregate's model
when: Reads the imports of every aggregate's queries.ts and of each projection's file.
then: Expects no query handler or projection to import a repository.ts or an aggregate's model.ts, and each query handler to read only its read model's projection.

title: Data that breaks the model is refused when it is written, across tables
when: With rows that break a key, a CHECK, a foreign key or a validation query (a step fulfilling another use case's requirement, a policy hearing two events, a field with two types, an ID outside its scope, a test with no file), loads or writes each through the store.
then: The store refuses each one then, naming its row and rule, and nothing is saved; no check is left to find it later.

title: A refused command leaves the data and the files as they were
when: A command that breaks the model is applied with others.
then: The whole write is refused and the data and its files stay as they were.

title: Every interface names one specific command: each command definition matches its command, handler, endpoint and CLI records, one to one
when: Reads every aggregate's command definitions and Lathe's command, command handler, endpoint and CLI command records.
then: Expects each definition to name one command record whose handler names its file, its endpoint its route and its CLI command its invocation, and no record without a definition.

title: The one Button component draws every standalone action: ghost, primary, icon, with an icon, danger, and a link drawn as a button
when: Renders the Button as ghost, primary submit, icon, with the `plus` icon, danger, and as a link to `/DM`; reads the app stylesheet.
then: Expects each its element, type and classes (`button button-ghost`, `button button-primary`, `icon-button`, `button button-ghost button-danger`), a click handled, `buttonClass` giving the same classes, and the stylesheet to style them once: the ghost hover tint, the primary steel fill and a 44 px target on a coarse pointer.

title: No kind, column, flag or check records an exception to a rule
when: Reads the schema, the check rows, the CLI's flags and the plugin's skills.
then: Expects no kind or column that records an exception, waiver or deviation, no applies-when or not-applicable opt-out, no check clause that exempts a kind and no flag that skips a rule.

title: Changes are hard cutovers: no redirect, alias, legacy path or second signature is left
when: The app and the engine sources are scanned.
then: No redirect, alias, legacy path or second addressOf signature is found.

title: What serves no purpose is removed: no unused file, export or dependency
when: Runs knip on `app/`, `lathe/` and `desktop/`.
then: It finds no unused file, export, dependency or binary.

title: No command or icon outlives its purpose: every keymap command is handled and reachable, every named command is in the keymap, and every icon is drawn
when: Reads the app's source, its keymap and its icon table.
then: Expects no command unhandled or unreachable, no command named outside the keymap, and no icon drawn nowhere.

title: No style outlives its purpose: every class selector in the app stylesheets is used in app/src
when: Reads the app's stylesheets and source, and asks whether a class name nothing uses, and `graph-page`, are used.
then: Expects no unused class selector in the app's stylesheets, `a-class-nothing-names` reported unused and `graph-page` used.

title: Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library check clean and wholly proved on every merge into main
manual_reason: Run as the merge gate: before each merge into main, the coordinator runs `npm --prefix lathe run check` on the merged branch and refuses the merge on any error, warning or obligation short of designed, built and proved.
when: Runs `npm --prefix lathe run check` at the repo root on the branch about to merge into main.
then: Expects 0 errors, 0 warnings, and every coverage line at 100% designed, built and proved in both products.
